text:
maria: Heads up — docs PR #842 for the air-gapped installer is missing a KMS/HSM example (PKCS#11) and the network port matrix link is 404. Can someone take a look? cc @sam_docs
 dave: I can pick this up. Which page path is it on?
 maria: /docs/private/install/airgap.md — around the ‘KMS integration’ section, there's just a placeholder and the port matrix link points to /docs/private/network/port-matrix.md which 404s.
 sam_docs: On it. I'll add a minimal pkcs11 snippet and fix the link. Any preferred HSM vendor example? Yubico, Thales, or keep it vendor-neutral?
 jin: Please keep it vendor-neutral. A short example we use in our test cluster is fine, e.g.:
```
# example env vars for PKCS11-backed KMS
PKCS11_MODULE=/opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so
REDWOOD_KMS_PKCS11_URI=pkcs11:token=redwood;manufacturer=Acme
HSM_PIN_FILE=/etc/redwood/hsm-pin
```
 Also add a note about protecting the PIN file (chmod 640) and a systemd ExecStartPre to chown it.
 dave: Also add the firewall/ports callout — make sure we explicitly say not to expose 2379/2380 to the public internet. For airgapped installs call out outbound SNAT for control-plane egress to STS endpoints.
 maria: Yup — minimal matrix + secure-by-default callout (don't expose etcd/raft ports). And a short troubleshooting link about cert chains for offline installs (customers trip on CA bundles).
 sam_docs: Drafted and pushed commit 9f3b2a: fixed relative link, added a compact port matrix, vendor-neutral PKCS11 snippet, and the systemd drop-in example for PIN permissions: 
```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.service.d/10-hsm-pin.conf
[Service]
Environment=HSM_PIN_FILE=/etc/redwood/hsm-pin
ExecStartPre=/bin/chown redwood:root /etc/redwood/hsm-pin
ExecStartPre=/bin/chmod 640 /etc/redwood/hsm-pin
```
 Also added a short note: "Do not store unwrapped keys in application-level files; prefer key wrapping with HSM or KMS interface."
 ops-bot: docs-ci | Pull request #842 started tests — lint: pass, linkcheck: fail (1 broken link)
 dave: Linkcheck failed — which link is broken now?
 ops-bot: docs-ci | Broken link -> /docs/private/network/port-matrix.md -> 404
 sam_docs: Fixed the path to /docs/private/network/ports.md and pushed. Running linkcheck again.
 ops-bot: docs-ci | Pull request #842 linkcheck: pass, spellcheck: warning (1)
 jin: For the HSM paragraph, add one sentence clarifying that HSM usage with KMS should emphasize key wrapping vs implying raw key material is kept in HSM slots accessible to apps. That avoids confusion with cert store usage.
 maria: Good catch. Can you add the cert-chain quickstart note too?
 sam_docs: Added both edits and a small troubleshooting anchor for cert chains in the airgap quickstart. Ready for review.
 dave: LGTM from infra side.
 maria: Looks good, merging now.
 ops-bot: docs-ci | Pull request #842 merged by maria — deploy to staging triggered.
 sam_docs: Thanks all — will watch the staging deploy and open a tiny follow-up for the spellcheck warning.
